title: The rain gauge
logline: A plastic rain gauge nailed to the garage's doorframe, half full, the rain still falling into it. The page measures January the way the strip never did: with a number it won't letter.

panels.composition: A plastic rain gauge nailed to a garage doorframe half full of water with rain still falling into it, the alley gray beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a plastic rain gauge nailed to a garage doorframe half full of water with rain still falling into it, a gray alley beyond, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
